questions.prompt: Which keyword prevents a class from being subclassed?
questions.explanation: A final class cannot be extended.

questions.prompt: How many bits does an int occupy in Java?
questions.explanation: Java fixes int at 32 bits on every platform.

questions.prompt: If two objects are equal according to equals(), what does the Java contract require of hashCode()?
questions.explanation: Equal objects must return the same hash code, otherwise hash-based collections misbehave.

questions.prompt: What do Integer a = 127, b = 127; a == b and Integer c = 128, d = 128; c == d evaluate to with default settings?
questions.explanation: Integer.valueOf caches values from -128 to 127, so boxed 127 refers to one object while 128 creates separate objects.
